records.summary: The operator says no real-money payment or platform purchase is required for participation, purchases do not enhance winning chances, and sweepstakes are void where prohibited by law.

A prize is not deemed awarded until rule compliance, necessary verification with written confirmation, and successful redemption. A sworn eligibility declaration may be requested; failure to complete verification within 30 days of written request may forfeit prizes.

Before prize redemption, the operator may require government-issued identification, eligibility affidavit or declaration, publicity/liability release, and tax forms; failure to meet requirements by the stated deadline may result in disqualification and forfeiture.

Sweepstakes Credits, Redeemable Sweeps Coins, and unredeemed Prizes are forfeited when an account becomes inactive or when the participant closes the account; reinstatement is at the operator's sole discretion.

The operator may conduct identification, credit, and other verification at registration, virtual-asset acquisition, or redemption, including PEP, sanctions, credit-history, background, source-of-wealth, payment-method, and financial-crime checks; it may request ID, proof of residence, and source-of-funds evidence.

The operator may suspend, restrict, or close an account and place redemption requests on hold during verification; it may discontinue verification and suspend, restrict, or close an account if requested information or documents are not provided within 30 days.

If the operator believes a participant has engaged in fraudulent, unlawful, or improper conduct, it may immediately suspend, restrict, or close the account, will not process associated redemptions, and may disclose information to regulators or law enforcement.
